_comment: Voiceover scripts read in a human voice on the booth (video-voiceover-lines.cjs) and laid onto their video by tools/video/neath-walkthrough/voiceover.py. One line per caption step; `segment` names the stretch of the video the line is spoken over, `aimSec` is the natural length shown to the reader, `fitSec` the longest take the segment holds (the composer asserts every segment is at least fitSec + 0.5 s). These are NOT course content: a take files as an English clip of the voice and is linked to no learner slot.

videos.title: Neath video
videos.about: The NPTC walkthrough video (job #542): one line per caption step, read over the screen it describes. Aran, 2026-10-29: in his own voice, never a clone or TTS.

lines.label: Title card
lines.text: Here's how to get started with SaySomethingin.

lines.label: Staff, step 1
lines.text: Open the teacher link your administrator sent you. Type your name and your staff email, then tap Continue.

lines.label: Staff, step 2
lines.text: Next, you'll be asked to set a password. You can't skip this step, so choose one you'll remember.

lines.label: Staff, step 3
lines.text: You'll land on My Classes. Tap New class, give it a name, pick the course, and tap Create Class. Your class will show as Welsh (South).

lines.label: Staff, step 4
lines.text: Open your class and tap Manage class. In the Invite students box, tap Copy invite link.

lines.label: Staff, step 5
lines.text: If a box asks 'Can we reach you here?', you can tap Not now.

lines.label: Staff, step 4 (link copied)
lines.text: Then post the link on your class Teams page.

lines.label: Staff, good to know
lines.text: For one shared link, always use Manage class, not the Invite students button.

lines.label: Staff, step 6
lines.text: To learn together, tap Play as class and share your screen. Students can also work at their own pace, with headphones in. Tap End session when you're finished.

lines.label: Students, step 1
lines.text: Open the link your lecturer shared.

lines.label: Students, step 2
lines.text: Type your name. The email box says Optional, but please type your college email, so you can sign back in on any device. Then tap Start learning.

lines.label: Students, step 3
lines.text: That's it. You're in, and ready to go.

lines.label: Students, class list
lines.text: Your lecturer will see your name on the class list.

lines.label: Tip: sign-in codes
lines.text: Sign-in codes come by email. If one doesn't arrive, check your junk or quarantine folder.

lines.label: Tips: if you get stuck
lines.text: Three quick tips. Join on the device you'll learn on. Type your college email. And if you ever see 'Too many tries', wait a few minutes, or switch to mobile data.

lines.label: End card
lines.text: You're all set. Enjoy learning Welsh!
